01 — About

Profile Summary

I'm finishing up my B.Com at Vels Institute, Chennai, and building toward a teaching career centered on making commerce and accountancy actually make sense — not just something to memorize before an exam. My background is a mix of commerce fundamentals, hands-on HR work, and a genuine, self-taught interest in applied AI.

During my internship at Eagle Hitech Softcloud Pvt. Ltd., I handled HR documentation, employee records, and onboarding — work that pushed me to communicate clearly and stay organized under a real workload. Around the same time, I wrote a 7-chapter e-book on prompt engineering and built an HR Analytics Dashboard in Excel. Both came from the same instinct: take something messy and structure it so it's easier to follow.

I've also completed Anthropic's AI Fluency certifications for both educators and students, plus a few Google Cloud generative AI badges. I think teachers who understand the AI tools their students already use are in a much better position to guide them.

Aura Risk Analysis

A single-file, client-side analytics dashboard that scores 100,000 synthetic student records to flag who's at risk, based on attendance, late assignments, and grades. Includes a What-If simulation engine for testing scenarios in real time. Built with Tailwind CSS (custom cyberpunk theme), Chart.js v4, and vanilla ES6+, using the Box-Muller transform and Pearson correlation under the hood.

🚀 Launch Project
